@graph.headline: Website Maintenance for Healthcare Businesses: What Clinics and Hospitals Must Keep Updated
@graph.description: Running a clinic, hospital, or diagnostic centre in India? This guide covers the specific website maintenance priorities for healthcare businesses.

mainEntity.name: Does a small single-doctor clinic really need professional website maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — a small clinic has no IT team to respond when something goes wrong. Professional maintenance with a defined response SLA ensures someone responds within hours, not days.

mainEntity.name: Do we need special healthcare-compliant hosting for our clinic website?

acceptedAnswer.text: India does not currently mandate specific healthcare-compliant hosting in the way HIPAA does, but the DPDP Act, 2023 imposes data protection obligations.

mainEntity.name: Our booking system is on a third-party platform (e.g. Practo, Calendly). Does the website still need maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your website pages patients visit before clicking through to book still need to be fast, secure, and accurate, and booking links require regular testing.

mainEntity.name: How often should we update doctor profiles and service information?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any time there is a change. Additionally, a monthly sweep of all profile and service pages should be part of your maintenance routine.

mainEntity.name: Can GA Digital Solutions maintain websites built on Practo, Wix, or custom platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text: We maintain healthcare websites across all major platforms including WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, and custom-built websites.

mainEntity.name: Is a verbal or email-based maintenance agreement enforceable in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: A verbal agreement is technically enforceable under the Indian Contract Act, 1872, but proving its terms in a dispute is extremely difficult without written evidence. A proper written agreement is the appropriate standard.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my current provider does not have a written agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask for one. Request a scope-of-service document that covers the key maintenance clauses. A professional provider should produce this without resistance.

mainEntity.name: How long should a maintenance contract term be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Month-to-month is ideal for a new relationship. Once trust is established over 2–3 months, an annual arrangement with a 10–20% discount is reasonable.

mainEntity.name: What should the exit or handover process look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional exit process includes: all credentials handed back in a documented handover file, a maintenance summary state, and removal of provider admin access within 5–7 business days.

mainEntity.name: Does GA Digital Solutions provide a written maintenance agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every GA Digital Solutions maintenance engagement is covered by a written agreement that includes an explicit scope of services, SLA, backup specification, reporting commitment, ownership clause, and exit terms.
